notes.note: Generic speech-to-text mangling drug names and dosages is a real clinical-documentation hazard, and a specialty-aware repair layer is a legitimate wedge. $29/provider/mo clinics is priced to the pain. Niche but deep — the buyer feels this one daily.
Correct transcript highlights terms/dosages; review highlight clickable; zero errors.
